description: The item's nutrition panel as a given country would print it (rounding, basis, mandatory nutrients, salt vs sodium, carbohydrate definition). Values that cannot be derived exactly come back null with the reason; derived rows (salt from sodium, kJ from kcal) list derived_from. "allergens" lists the regime's declared allergens the item contains; it is null, with a note, when no source declares allergens for the item, and [] only when a source states it contains none.

id.description: Entity id, e.g. fd_k3m9x2q8vt7w4p (food), pr_ (product), sp_ (supplement), mi_ (menu item), rc_ (recipe). A source id also works: fdc:<USDA fdcId>, ndb:<NDB number>, dsld:<DSLD id>, fndds:<food code>, lnhpd:<LNHPD id>, ciqual:<alim_code>, cnf:<food code>, cofid:<food code>, matvaretabellen:<food id>, slv:<Livsmedelsverket number>.

regime.description: US, CA, EU, UK, AU_NZ, JP, CN, CODEX
